page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Hebrew, Syriac and Latin mixed in the lines; no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: Caput. Sumitur latè, ut etiam vox Hebraica & Latina. Pro summitate alicujus rei, Vertex, Fastigium: Summum, Primarium, Præcipuum, Præstantissimum: Summus, Supremus, Princeps, Dux, Caput: Hinc [Hebrew] Dux quartæ scil. partis, Tetrarcha, Luc.3.1. [Hebrew] Caput patrum, Patriarcha, Act.2.29. [Hebrew] Princeps vitæ, cap.3.15. Principium, Primum: [Hebrew] De novo, Denuò, Johan.3.3. ad Tit.3.5. Plural. [Hebrew] [Hebrew] Capita: Principes, Primores.
[Hebrew] Syr. Princeps. Ad hanc formam in Targum est [Hebrew], Proverb.25.15. Plur. [Hebrew] Principes, Primores, Lucæ 18.18.
[Syriac], [Syriac] Syriac. Initium, Principium, Primum, Primitiæ. Plur. [Syriac] ad Hebr.7.4.
[Syriac] Syr. Primus, Præcipuus, Principalis: Fœmin. [Syriac] Prima, Primaria, Lucæ 15.22.

[Hebrew] [Hebrew] Chald. & Syr. Multum, magnum esse vel fieri, multiplicari, augeri, augescere, crescere, germinare: & activè, Germinare facere, producere, quod melius legeretur ex forma Pahel, Jobi 38.27. Item Jaculari, Genes. 21.20. Respondet etiam quandoque Hebraeo [Hebrew] Vocavit, ut Exod. 31.2. Jesa. 42.6. Pahel [Hebrew] Magnificare: augere, multiplicare,

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Syriac-script forms are printed with vowel points and dots; they were not reproduced letter by letter, so the placeholders [Hebrew] and [Syriac] stand for them. The Hebrew and Syriac glyphs are partly damaged in the scan. Show-through from the reverse page is visible in the margins and was left out.
